title: Fullscreen Digital Clock
description: A beautiful, customizable fullscreen digital clock for productivity, studying, and desk display.

faq.q: How do I toggle fullscreen mode?
faq.a: Click the 'Toggle Fullscreen Mode' button, or press the 'F11' key on your keyboard. Press 'Escape' to exit fullscreen at any time.
Yes. The clock hooks directly into your system time and uses high-precision requestAnimationFrame animations to render frame changes instantly.
